title: Winged Angel with Fleur-de-Lis
description: A central female angel with large white and purple feathered wings, curly golden hair, and a glowing pink heart at her chest stands with arms outstretched. She is surrounded by colorful swirling energy patterns, floating orbs containing miniature angels and starry scenes, and a large golden fleur-de-lis symbol glowing in the starry upper right against a vibrant cosmic background.
prompt: A majestic female angel with large white and purple feathered wings and curly golden hair floats in the center, wearing a flowing white and gold gown with a bright pink glowing heart radiating concentric circles from her chest. Her arms are outstretched as she is surrounded by swirling green, pink and purple cosmic energy, floating transparent orbs containing tiny angels and starry galaxies, colorful dots and ribbons, and a large glowing golden fleur-de-lis symbol in the starry upper right corner.
